audit.whatIsWrong: Stage whys were generic and no cooldown appeared anywhere on the page.
audit.why: Test of Spirit is 16s at rank 1 falling to 12s, Tentacle Smash shrinks 10s to 6s while your Counter Strike is still 15s at rank 3, Harsh Lesson is a 4s dash-auto that drags every nearby tentacle onto you, and Leap of Faith is 120s at rank 1. Those four numbers are what make levels 3-5 unplayable for you and 6 uncontestable.
audit.corrected: Real cooldowns written into the stage whys, the cooldown block and Key Ability Interactions.

audit.why: The decisive interaction is already stated correctly in five places: Counter Strike dodges her basic attacks, never the tentacle slams, so popping E inside her field does nothing. Riot's text agrees — E dodges incoming attacks and tentacle swings are passive-driven ability damage. Left alone.

edits.before: Auto-trade only with E held in your pocket. Identify how Illaoi contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: One point in Tentacle Smash and no grab yet — swing autos, watch where she plants tentacles, and path around them.

edits.before: Counter Strike flips every AA exchange he starts. Only take the trade when Illaoi's Test of Spirit is down.
edits.after: Test of Spirit (16s) plus a tentacle slam beats your level-2 trade, and your dodge does nothing to the slams.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Illaoi must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Your full combo is online but dead inside her field — commit only when she steps off her tentacles and E is down.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Test of Spirit's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: She owns the ground around her tentacles: Tentacle Smash shrinks to a 6s slam while Counter Strike is still 15s. Farm the edge.

edits.before: Grandmaster’s Might stats win every extended duel from here on. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Illaoi's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Leap of Faith (120s at rank 1) lights up the whole tentacle ring and her healing eats your burst — never contest her 6 all-in.

edits.before: Trinity Force is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Test of Spirit's cooldown.
edits.after: Her first item stacks more field damage and healing before Trinity Force tips the duel — stall the wave.

edits.before: - Illaoi Test of Spirit: matchup-defining — Dodging this is the whole matchup. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Illaoi Test of Spirit: matchup-defining — 16s at rank 1, and dodging it is the whole lane. - Harsh Lesson: 4s, the dash-auto that drags every nearby tentacle onto you. - Your ultimate: kill windows only.

edits.before: Track Illaoi's Test of Spirit: Dodging this is the whole matchup. When it is down — Q-E-W her.
edits.after: Track Test of Spirit (16s): dodging it is the whole matchup. Once it is spent — Q-E-W her.

edits.before: Overall difficulty: 6/10. The lane is decided by how well you track Test of Spirit and how disciplined your pattern is.
edits.after: Overall difficulty: 7.5/10. The lane is decided by how well you dodge Test of Spirit and how disciplined your pattern is.

edits.before: Even matchup — difficulty 6/10, Illaoi carry threat 7/10.
edits.after: Hard matchup — difficulty 7.5/10, Illaoi carry threat 7/10.

notes: The interaction work on this page was already right (Counter Strike dodges her autos, never the tentacle slams), so I only added timers and fixed the chart. Two things for the user: (1) LEVEL 1 — the mirror's summary says it set rows 0-5 to Illaoi, but the packet chart says Skill at Level 1 and this page's whys[0] says "Level 1 is even"; I set Skill to match the packet and the prose, so if mirror-check flags Level 1 the mirror is the side that should move. (2) UNVERIFIED — the mirror asserts Leap of Faith grounds Leap Strike and Empower, and the kit's derived flags do list grounding on her R, but Riot's own R description says only damage plus a tentacle per champion hit. Per the calibration rule I did not write the grounding claim onto this page; it needs a ruling, because if it is true it belongs in the level-6 spike on both sides. The packet's four suspectNames here are all false positives.
